general1.event: You linger around the Clan border, but flee when you hear a patrol.

general2.event: You wonder if your former Clanmates really miss you.

general3.event: As you tuck into your nest for the night, you look up at Silverpelt and wonder if you'll ever make it there.

general4.event: You miss the warm seclusion of your previous Clan's dens as it rains yet again, drenching you as you fail to find coverage.

shunned5.event: If you were to leave tonight, would you go unnoticed? Would the Clan search for you?

shunned6.event: A small part of you wishes r_c:0 would just get this over with and exile you already.
